subject: Mathematics

questions.q: If 20% of a number is added to 90, then the result is the same number. 80% of the same number is:
questions.explain: Let the number be $x$. $0.20x + 90 = x \Rightarrow x - 0.20x = 90 \Rightarrow 0.80x = 90$. Thus, 80% of the number ($0.80x$) is exactly 90.

questions.q: The cost of a washing machine is 40% less than the cost of a TV. If the cost of the washing machine increases by 52% and that of the TV decreases by 76%, then what is the percentage change in the total cost of 5 washing machines and 2 TVs?
questions.explain: Let the cost of one TV be 100. Then the washing machine costs 60. Old total cost $= 5 \times 60 + 2 \times 100 = 300 + 200 = 500$. New washing machine cost $= 60 \times (1 + 0.52) = 60 \times 1.52 = 91.2$. New TV cost $= 100 \times (1 - 0.76) = 24$. New total cost $= 5 \times 91.2 + 2 \times 24 = 456 + 48 = 504$. Change $= 504 - 500 = +4$. Percentage change $= (4 / 500) \times 100\% = 0.8\%$ increase.

questions.explain: Let the required percentage be $x\%$. Therefore, $(x / 100) \times (10 / 40) = 1 / 20$. Since $10 / 40 = 1 / 4$, we have $x / 400 = 1 / 20$. Multiplying both sides by 400 gives $x = 400 / 20 = 20$. So, it is 20%.
